title: Toyota is taking the Corolla electric

paragraphs.en: Toyota is preparing to introduce the electric version of its best-selling car of all time, the Corolla.
paragraphs.zh: 丰田正准备推出其史上最畅销车型卡罗拉（Corolla）的电动版。

paragraphs.en: With over 57 million sold worldwide since it went on sale in 1966, the Toyota Corolla is widely considered the best-selling vehicle to date.
paragraphs.zh: 自1966年上市以来，丰田卡罗拉（Toyota Corolla）全球销量已超过5700万辆，被广泛认为是迄今为止最畅销的汽车。

paragraphs.en: The Corolla has undergone 12 model changes, but the upcoming version will look (and feel) very different from its predecessors.
paragraphs.zh: 卡罗拉已经经历了12次车型换代，但即将推出的版本在外观（和体验）上将与前代车型大不相同。

paragraphs.en: Toyota offered a sneak peek of the new Corolla in concept form almost a year ago at the Japan Mobility Show.
paragraphs.zh: 丰田近一年前的日本移动出行展上以概念车形式抢先展示了新款卡罗拉。

paragraphs.en: “How should the Corolla evolve?” Toyota CEO Koji Sato asked those in attendance. The Japanese automaker is planning a drastic overhaul, including a sleek new design, high-tech interior, and updated platform.
paragraphs.zh: “卡罗拉该如何进化？”丰田首席执行官佐藤恒治向在场人士问道。 这家日本汽车制造商正计划进行一次大刀阔斧的革新，包括时尚的新设计、高科技内饰以及升级的平台。

sents.en: “How should the Corolla evolve?” Toyota CEO Koji Sato asked those in attendance.
sents.zh: “卡罗拉该如何进化？”丰田首席执行官佐藤恒治向在场人士问道。

sents.en: The Japanese automaker is planning a drastic overhaul, including a sleek new design, high-tech interior, and updated platform.
sents.zh: 这家日本汽车制造商正计划进行一次大刀阔斧的革新，包括时尚的新设计、高科技内饰以及升级的平台。

paragraphs.en: Although it’s expected to use the same TNGA-C architecture as the current Corolla, Toyota is expected to introduce a heavily modified version of the platform that supports all powertrains, including pure electric.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然预计它将采用与现款卡罗拉相同的 TNGA-C 架构，但丰田有望推出该平台的深度改进版本，以支持包括纯电动在内的所有动力系统。

paragraphs.en: “Whether it’s a battery EV, plug-in hybrid, hybrid, or internal combustion engine vehicle―whatever the power source―let’s make good-looking cars that everyone will want to drive!” Toyota’s CEO said at the Japan Mobility Show.
paragraphs.zh: 「无论是纯电动汽车、插电式混合动力车、混合动力车，还是内燃机汽车——无论动力来源是什么——让我们打造人人都想驾驶的、外观漂亮的汽车吧！」丰田的首席执行官在日本移动出行展上如此说道。

paragraphs.en: Toyota’s current chairman and former CEO, Akio Toyoda, warned in an exclusive interview with Japanese media NHK in July that the company is being forced to adapt, or “it cannot survive,” amid new competition and technology from China.
paragraphs.zh: 丰田现任董事长、前首席执行官丰田章男今年7月在接受日本媒体NHK独家专访时警告称，面对来自中国的新竞争和新技术，公司被迫做出调整，否则“就无法生存”。

paragraphs.en: The special broadcast went behind the scenes at the “top secret” next-gen Corolla development site.
paragraphs.zh: 这期特别节目深入探访了“绝密”的下一代卡罗拉开发现场。

paragraphs.en: We even caught a glimpse of several different Corolla Concept body types, including a sedan, hatchback, crossover, and GR model in the background.
paragraphs.zh: 我们甚至瞥见了几种不同版本的卡罗拉概念车车型，包括背景中的一辆轿车、掀背车、跨界车和 GR 车型。

paragraphs.en: While Toyota has kept most details secret so far, the next-gen Corolla is expected to come in several powertrains, including gas, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, and battery electric.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然丰田迄今为止对大部分细节保密，但预计下一代卡罗拉将提供多种动力系统，包括汽油、混合动力、插电式混合动力和纯电动。

paragraphs.en: Toyota engineers told Car and Driver that the hybrid will use a new 1.5-liter four-cylinder engine with an electric motor, delivering about 134 horsepower combined.
paragraphs.zh: 丰田的工程师告诉《Car and Driver》，该混动系统将采用一台全新的1.5升四缸发动机搭配电动机，综合输出功率约为134马力。

paragraphs.en: The hybrid system will be roughly 10% to 20% more efficient than the current setup, and an AWD version is possible.
paragraphs.zh: 该混合动力系统将比现有配置效率提升大约 10% 至 20%，并且还可能推出四驱版本。

paragraphs.en: I really wish Honda would have done this for the Civic, but considering how they're handling electric vehicles these days, I'm glad they didn't.
paragraphs.zh: 我真希望本田当初能为思域这么做，但考虑到他们如今对待电动汽车的方式，我很庆幸他们没有这么做。

paragraphs.en: Honda is now the only major car maker not investing in electrification for North America, and they're definitely going to regret that, especially considering how expensive gas and diesel now is.
paragraphs.zh: 本田目前是唯一没有在北美投资电动化的主要汽车制造商，他们肯定会为此感到后悔，尤其是考虑到现在汽油和柴油的价格有多昂贵。

paragraphs.en: Toyota will also introduce the first plug-in hybrid and pure electric Corolla models. The PHEV will use a larger battery, offering a longer electric driving range, but Toyota has yet to reveal specifics.
paragraphs.zh: 丰田还将推出首款插电式混合动力版和纯电动版卡罗拉车型。 该插电式混合动力车将采用更大的电池，提供更长的纯电续航里程，但丰田尚未公布具体细节。

sents.en: Toyota will also introduce the first plug-in hybrid and pure electric Corolla models.
sents.zh: 丰田还将推出首款插电式混合动力版和纯电动版卡罗拉车型。

sents.en: The PHEV will use a larger battery, offering a longer electric driving range, but Toyota has yet to reveal specifics.
sents.zh: 该插电式混合动力车将采用更大的电池，提供更长的纯电续航里程，但丰田尚未公布具体细节。

paragraphs.en: The Toyota Corolla EV is expected to be available in single- and dual-motor configurations with a driving range of at least 250 miles.
paragraphs.zh: 丰田卡罗拉EV预计将提供单电机和双电机两种配置，续航里程至少为250英里。

paragraphs.en: Whether or not Toyota will bring the Corolla EV to the US is still up in the air. Toyota’s next-gen Corolla is expected to make its debut sometime in 2027 as a 2028 model year.
paragraphs.zh: 丰田是否会将卡罗拉纯电动车引入美国市场仍不确定。 丰田下一代卡罗拉预计将于2027年某个时候首次亮相，作为2028年款车型。

sents.en: Whether or not Toyota will bring the Corolla EV to the US is still up in the air.
sents.zh: 丰田是否会将卡罗拉纯电动车引入美国市场仍不确定。

sents.en: Toyota’s next-gen Corolla is expected to make its debut sometime in 2027 as a 2028 model year.
sents.zh: 丰田下一代卡罗拉预计将于2027年某个时候首次亮相，作为2028年款车型。

paragraphs.en: We will learn prices closer to launch, but according to Car and Driver , the gas version will likely start at around $25,000, the hybrid around $27,000, and the EV and PHEVs will likely be priced in the $30,000 range.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将在临近发布时了解到更确切的价格，但据 Car and Driver 报道，燃油版起价可能在 25,000 美元左右，混动版约为 27,000 美元，而纯电动版和插电混动版的价格可能在 30,000 美元区间。
